text: あなたも　おはか　まいりに　きたの？

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: おはか　まいりに　きた
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of coming or going tells what you came to do. おはか　まいりに　きた = 'came to visit a grave'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, casual question. きたの？ = 'did you come?'
